mapper.select: SELECT CASE COUNT(1) WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RES FROM APP_KV WHERE K = #{key} AND (EXPIRE_AT IS NULL OR EXPIRE_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
SELECT V FROM APP_KV WHERE K = #{key} AND (EXPIRE_AT IS NULL OR EXPIRE_AT > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: INSERT INTO APP_KV ( K , V , EXPIRE_AT , UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{key} , #{value} , CASE WHEN #{expireMinute} > 0 THEN DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '+' || #{expireMinute} || ' minutes') ELSE NULL END , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT(K) DO UPDATE SET V = excluded.V, EXPIRE_AT = excluded.EXPIRE_AT, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE APP_KV SET EXPIRE_AT = CASE WHEN #{expireMinute} > 0 THEN DATETIME(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, '+' || #{expireMinute} || ' minutes') ELSE NULL END, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE K = #{key}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXPIRE_AT IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE CAST((JULIANDAY(EXPIRE_AT) - JULIANDAY(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) * 24 * 60 AS INTEGER) END AS MINUTES_REMAINING FROM APP_KV WHERE K = #{key}
mapper.delete: /* NO_LOG */ DELETE FROM APP_KV WHERE EXPIRE_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRE_AT <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
